question: In a certain code language, ‘DOING’ is written as ‘BQTOV’ and 'ZEBRA' is written as 'FAAKB'. How will ‘STORM’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'DOING’ is written as ‘BQTOV',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/064dd0137b45f3c6d839da09c4d262e30d01cd870cd705c5ad8e9727b44774f3.png] 

‘ZEBRA' is written as 'FAAKB’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd71ec8f15c9a8ffc5703a660e8bb39f45cee8a986ccd6f8e6a80b8b74ff3550.png] 

Similarly, for '**STORM**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d7df5c978902b1618aa439ce91f22bd612b90e7b483c0f363d92723f26ed141.png] 

So, 'STORM' will be written as '**MLNKP**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
